energy_note: Removed by arithmetic, not by a rule.

description: A group agrees a time. At eight o'clock, ninety accounts report the same three posts. By ten past, the account is suspended pending review. Nobody broke any platform rule.
energy_note: Ninety reports in ten minutes, and no rule broken.
